case_title.quote: RAKESH & ANOTHER v. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

number_of_accused.quote: The third person Dinesh did not prefer any appeal so we are not concerned with him
number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants are before the Court.

accused_gender.reason: Gender is not expressly stated; the judgment uses only names.

victim_gender.quote: one on the neck... Kailash had died... his body
victim_gender.reason: The victim, Kailash, is referred to as male ('his body').

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the accused had been very well known to the witness being resident of the same village
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Same village; the utensils dispute and threat are as alleged.

offence_category.quote: convicted for the offence punishable under Section 302 IPC

statutory_provisions.quote: FIR was lodged under Section 302 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ... and Section 25 of the Arms Act, 1959

weapon.quote: weapons such as knife, gupti and 'katarna'
weapon.reason: Knife, gupti and katarna/kalama axe are all noted.

evidence_type.quote: the arrest of accused, recovery of weapons on their disclosure statements proved the prosecution case
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and recovery evidence were relied on.

confession.quote: weapons used in the offence were recovered on their disclosure statements

aggravating_circumstances.quote: falsely enrope the appellants and other accused in such a heinous crime
aggravating_circumstances.reason: The Court calls it a heinous crime; multiple wounds are noted.

trial_court_outcome.quote: awarded sentence of rigorous imprisonment for life and a fine of Rs. 2,000/- each

high_court_outcome.quote: the appeals have been heard afresh and dismissed vide judgment and order dated 15.12.2006

final_outcome.quote: Appeal lacks merit and is, accordingly, dismissed.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life term, so no fixed years.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary without 'on a market day'; the judgment only says 'on the day of Hali'.
neutral_facts.quote: On 5.3.1996, on the day of 'Hali' at around 11.30 a.m.
neutral_facts.reason: 'Market day' is invented; the rest is supported and leaks no outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the s.302 punishment range.

physical_harm.quote: three incised wounds found on his body, one on the neck, one on the chest and another in the abdomen

number_of_offences.quote: convicted for the offence punishable under Section 302 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Only s.302 is shown as tried and convicted.

premeditation_planning.reason: The Court made no finding on premeditation.

motive.quote: Rakesh, accused, wanted utensils from Kailash (deceased), who refused to oblige

key_evidence_accepted.quote: PW.11 was a natural witness... The other circumstances particularly, the statements of the Investigating Officer (PW.21) and PW.9

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: The assailants fled the scene; weapons were recovered on their disclosure statements after arrest.
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment notes the accused fleeing and the disclosure statements.

custody_duration.quote: he had already served the sentence of more than 14 years... Appellant Rajesh has served about 7-1/2 years

legal_representation.quote: Siddharth Aggarwal, Aditya Wadhoa, Stui Gujral, Senthil Jagadeesan for the Appellant. Vibha Datta Makhija for the Respondent.

procedural_irregularity.quote: decided by judgment and order dated 10.2.2005 in absence of their counsel

appeal_history.quote: remanded the appeals to be heard by the High Court afresh

prosecution_argument.quote: no rule of law prohibiting reliance upon the evidence of the close relatives of the victims

defence_argument.quote: The ocular evidence is contradictory to the medical evidence

legal_principle_applied.quote: ocular evidence would have primacy unless it is established that oral evidence is totally irreconcilable

precedent_relied_upon.quote: State of U.P. v. Hari Chand, (2009) 13 SCC 542
